answer: Attackers face rising costs as bonds are slashed on failed verification, so flooding the ocean of identities with fake agents gets expensive fast. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted work attestations tied to a verifiable wharf identity: each agent must post a bond and complete physical task proofs at the wharf before earning trust. Honest peers also cross-check proofs against the daily tide of transactions, making large-volume forgery both costly and detectable. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
